title: 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach

scenes.headline: Most Powerful 911
scenes.narration: Unleashing a staggering 700 horsepower, this beast surpasses all previous road-going 911s.

scenes.headline: Porsche Heritage
scenes.narration: The prominent front splitter and air intakes enhance not just looks but the 911's aerodynamic prowess.

scenes.headline: $700K Sold Price
scenes.narration: With a recent sell price of $700,000, this GT2 RS shows impressive appreciation from its original MSRP.

scenes.headline: Aerodynamic Mastery
scenes.narration: The front air intakes framed in glossy black mesh boost cooling efficiency significantly.

scenes.headline: Track-Ready Design
scenes.narration: The adjustable rear wing reflects a commitment to track performance, with its aerodynamic benefits.

scenes.headline: Aerodynamic Excellence
scenes.narration: Dual-element rear wing supports this track-focused Porsche in both stability and speed.

scenes.headline: 700 HP, 553 lb-ft
scenes.narration: Its 3.8-liter twin-turbo engine delivers a jaw-dropping 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque.

scenes.headline: Power to the Rear

scenes.headline: Rival: Lamborghini Huracán
scenes.narration: Stacked against the Lamborghini Huracán, the GT2 RS's 700 horses outrun the Huracán's 602 hp.

scenes.headline: Performance Question
scenes.narration: For those with the means, would you invest in such engineering excellence, or opt for another thrill?

script: Unleashing a staggering 700 horsepower, this beast surpasses all previous road-going 911s. The prominent front splitter and air intakes enhance not just looks but the 911's aerodynamic prowess. With a recent sell price of $700,000, this GT2 RS shows impressive appreciation from its original MSRP. The front air intakes framed in glossy black mesh boost cooling efficiency significantly. The adjustable rear wing reflects a commitment to track performance, with its aerodynamic benefits. Dual-element rear wing supports this track-focused Porsche in both stability and speed. Its 3.8-liter twin-turbo engine delivers a jaw-dropping 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Inside, carbon fiber touches emphasize its performance aims, visible on both the steering wheel and center console. Power is delivered solely to the rear wheels, maximizing performance and driving thrill. Stacked against the Lamborghini Huracán, the GT2 RS's 700 horses outrun the Huracán's 602 hp. For those with the means, would you invest in such engineering excellence, or opt for another thrill?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach, finished in Guards Red with a black interior. The odometer on this 911 GT2 RS currently displays approximately 3,900 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Porsche's past. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Weissach Package, 20-inch front and 21-inch rear magnesium wheels, PCCBs, a front axle lift system, an extended range fuel tank, leather and Alcantara upholstery, carbon fiber full bucket seats, and a Bose sound system. Notable modifications reported by the selling dealer are limited to black-finished brake calipers. Launched for 2018 as a limited-edition model, the 991-based GT2 RS stood proud as the most powerful road-going 911 ever released. Porsche went to significant lengths to make the model as light as possible -- it notably fitted lighter springs, numerous carbon fiber parts, and cloth interior door handles. The optional Weissach Package -- which this car is equipped with -- saved an additional 40 pounds. Most sources agree that Porsche built around 1,000 units of the 991-based 911 GT2 RS. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6, rated at 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: Weissach Package Chrono Package with preparation for Lap Trigger 20-inch front and 21-inch rear magnesium wheels in black Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB) Front axle lift system Rear axle steering Extended range fuel tank Leather and Alcantara upholstery Carbon fiber full bucket seats Bose sound system
sections.Seller Notes: The selling dealer notes that the paint protection film has been applied to exterior panels. The selling dealer states that the magnesium wheels were uninstalled early in the vehicle's life and have been reinstalled in preparation for the sale, and that its Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires have about 9/32 of tread.
